Package org.thewhitemage13.processor

Class UserProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.processor.UserProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserProcessorInterface
@Component public class UserProcessor extends Object implements UserProcessorInterface
Processor for managing user-related data transformations.

This class implements the UserProcessorInterface and provides methods to process the creation and retrieval of user data. It handles password encoding, and populates User entities based on incoming data from DTOs.

Key Features:

  • Processes user data for creation, including encoding passwords.
  • Transfers data from a User entity to a GetUserDTO for retrieval.
  • Supports integration with various user-related operations in the system.

      public void createProcessor(CreateUserDTO createUserDao, User updateUser, String phoneNumber)
      Processes user data for creation, including encoding the password.
